top.summary: Israel carried out several attacks in Gaza, including shelling the Nuseirat refugee camp.

articles.title: At least four Palestinians killed, several wounded in Israeli strikes across Gaza
articles.summary: At least four Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza on Saturday, and two girls died of burns from a fire in a tent sheltering displaced people, medical sources told the Palestinian news agency Wafa. In Gaza City, a Palestinian died in the morning of wounds from an earlier Israeli attack on the Tel al-Hawa neighbourhood, in the southwest of the city. In the evening, Wael Musallam died of injuries from a recent Israeli drone strike near al-Wehda Tower, in the west of the city…

articles.title: Israeli strike on Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza kills Palestinian
articles.summary: An Israeli airstrike on Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza killed a Palestinian man, Diaa Abu al-Rous, according to Quds News Network (QNN). Another Palestinian, Arafat al-Ar'eer, succumbed to wounds sustained in an Israeli airstrike on the Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood, south of Gaza City, according to QNN.

articles.title: Palestinian man injured in Israeli strike on Gaza succumbs, report says
articles.summary: A Palestinian man, Arafat al-Ar'eer, has succumbed to wounds sustained in an Israeli airstrike on the Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood, south of Gaza City, Quds News Network reported. On Friday evening, Wafa news agency reported that at least 12 Palestinians, including a man, his wife and their children, were injured in an Israeli drone strike targeting the al-Maslakh area, west of Khan Younis, in the southern Gaza Strip.
